title: The Hardware Store (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy absurdist family Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The hardware store knows what the problem is before you do
You walk in for one thing and leave with seventeen things too
Because the hardware store has the answer to every question
Including questions you didn't know you had — that's the suggestion

[Pre-Chorus]
I went once for a single screw of a specific type and gauge
And came out with a drill bit set, a level, and a sage
Philosophy about the nature of timber and its needs
The hardware store is where the Saturday morning always leads

[Chorus]
The hardware store knows something I don't know
It knows the solution to the problem three problems ahead in the flow
The hardware store has men in orange who appear when needed
And whose advice is given freely and should always be heeded
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
There's a smell to the hardware store that can't be manufactured elsewhere
Timber and machine oil and something industrial in the air
The big stores have cafes now which is progress of a kind
But the smell is still the same at the back — you'll find

[Bridge]
I took my boys to the hardware store on Saturdays when small
Pete and Corey and Joel — they understood it all
By seven years old they could tell the difference between a rawlplug and a masonry bit
And that education served them better than almost anything that's bit

[Outro]
Hardware store knows… the solution's in the third aisle… hardware store knows
That's my boy
